summary: Comprehensive 6-part executive presentation-readiness implementation plan covering: (1) Seamless PO -> GRN -> BILL -> PV pipeline flow, line quantity field normalization, and printable 3-Way Match Bill Summary modal in ProcurementPayablesHub.tsx; (2) Single-drawer exclusivity in QuotationStudioModal.tsx to prevent A4 preview squeeze; (3) Self-healing sanitizer in QuotationRepository.ts for legacy PV fallback lines, chained document prefixes, and total synchronization; (4) EnquiryDetail.tsx & ProjectRegistry.tsx Supplier PO persistence (Save PO & Save and Open in Studio) and Procurement & Margin Summary card; (5) Vendor 360° TRN, payment terms, and beneficiary bank details in CompanyModal.tsx & CreateCompanyModal.tsx; and (6) Full-app layout and build verification.
